entities.name: Natalija Stevanović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Natalija Stevanović is a Serbian inactive tennis player. She reached her best singles ranking of world No. 145 
on 17 July 2023. On 6 May 2024, she peaked at No. 152 in the WTA doubles rankings.
